title: Unified fashion CRM platform (website success story)
description: Rebuilt a CRM platform for an omnichannel fashion business (stores and e-commerce): data cleansing, customer deduplication with a stable CRM ID, profile enrichment, address harmonisation, transparent metric recalculation and redesigned Power BI reports.
company_role: Data cleansing, deduplication, 360-degree customer view, metric recalculation (Global Lifetime Value), Power BI reporting.
scope: Customer data platform on Google Cloud Platform, auditable history of data changes, Power BI dashboards.
outcomes: More than 3 million addresses completed; nearly 1 million new prospects added; unified customer view.
